title: Open the code behind a catalog entry
statement: As a developer, I can go from a catalog entry to the exact end-to-end test code that runs it, so I can read what is really being proven.
overview: This uses existing `test_implementation` evidence, which already pins exact code and goes stale. References for reading can sit anywhere, but a test runner needs the declaration: of the 58 references this Saga has into `e2e/tests`, 4 start on a `test()` line and 54 sit inside a test body or helper.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An entry's code references name exact lines and open at their pinned commit in the code drawer.
When that code changes, the entry shows as stale in the catalog, and `status` reports it as it does other test evidence.
An entry whose code cannot be read says so, and no other lines are shown in its place.
An entry says which of its code references is the line that declares each test it runs, and the catalog lists any entry with none as not runnable.
